product.label: Seed product
product.info: Used for related and complementary sources when not on a product page.

collection.label: Collection
collection.info: Required for collection, trending, new arrivals, and best sellers sources.

paragraph.content: Builds product packs and bundles with Shopify Cart AJAX and complementary recommendations. Future engines are extension points only.

nether_strategy.label: Bundle strategy
nether_strategy.info: FBT and Complete the look use complementary recommendations. Curated, packs, gift sets, and mix & match use product blocks, product lists, or collections. Future strategies are placeholders.

product.label: Seed product
product.info: Used for complete-the-look and FBT when not on a product page.

product_list.label: Bundle products
product_list.info: Quick curated list. Prefer Bundle product blocks for required/optional control.

collection.label: Collection
collection.info: Used for mix & match when no product list or blocks are set.

nether_display_discount_percent.label: Display discount percent
nether_display_discount_percent.info: Presentation only. Real discounts should use Shopify discounts or a future discount engine extension.

context.label: Context key
context.info: Used for unique progress IDs when multiple bars appear on one page.

visible.label: Show placeholder
visible.info: Hidden by default until a delivery provider is connected.

paragraph.content: Uses Shopify native pickup availability. Available on product templates.
